SELECT line.*, agree.AGREEMENT_CODE,agree.SUP_ID vendorId,agree.SUP_CODE vendorCode,agree.SUP_NAME vendorName,agree.CURRENCY_TYPE currencyName, agree.PAYMENT,agree.PAY_WAY,agree.AGREEMENT_TYPE, price.PRICE_TAX unitPrice,price.TAX_RATE taxRate,price.RATE_PRICE taxPrice, price.START_NUM FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_line line JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_jc_agreement_info price ON line.MATERIAL_ID = price.MATERIAL_ID JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_jc_agreement agree ON agree.AGREEMENT_ID = price.AGREEMENT_ID WHERE agree.AGREEMENT_STATUS = 'EXECUTING' AND agree.SUPPLY_AREA LIKE(CONCAT('%', line.EXT_AREA_CODE,'%')) AND agree.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE <= NOW() AND agree.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE >= NOW() AND line.EXT_POOL_STATUS = 'Y' AND line.EXT_BUY_TYPE IN('HAS_PRICE') AND line.ORDER_QUANTITY > 0 AND line.CEEA_PERFORM_USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_jc_agreement_org ao WHERE ao.AGREEMENT_ID = agree.AGREEMENT_ID AND ao.BUY_ORG_ID = line.ORG_ID)
AND line.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM like CONCAT('%',#{params.requirementHeadNum},'%')
AND line.MATERIAL_CODE like CONCAT('%',#{params.materialCode},'%')
AND line.EXT_USE_DEPARTMENT_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{params.extUseDepartmentName},'%')
AND line.ORG_ID = #{params.orgId}
AND line.ORG_ID in
#{item}
AND line.CEEA_PERFORM_USER_ID = #{params.ceeaPerformUserId}
AND line.MATERIAL_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{params.materialName},'%')
AND agree.SUP_NAME like CONCAT('%',#{params.vendorName},'%')
ORDER BY line.REQUIREMENT_LINE_ID DESC
